title: Code and results for: Prior-Anchored Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Vehicle MPC with Exact and Simplified Physics
description: Code, configuration files and stored results for the paper. The repository trains physics-informed neural networks for control (PINC) as prediction models for model predictive control of a car, with exact physics (single-track vehicle), simplified physics (double-track vehicle with Magic Formula tyres, variants M0 and M1) and an independent 14-degree-of-freedom vehicle from the MathWorks Vehicle Dynamics Blockset, and compares them with data-only networks, grey-box models and nonlinear MPC. The scripts in scripts/ generate every table, figure and number of the paper and its supplement from the stored results. MathWorks content (tyre data, Blockset vehicle) is not included.
